desc:
🐟 Welcome to Greedy Fish Stealer!

How to Play:
🐟 Catch and steal fish from guardian
🌱 Take risks in greedy pond to make them bigger and more valuable
💰 Earn money from fishes that in the tank
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and tank
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🥷 Steal fish from other players
✨ Discover rarer fish, sizes, and special variants!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
